outcome: Anterior and posterior diameter of the diaphragm
cohort: The participants were 90 postpartum women diagnosed with PFD (divided by delivery mode) and 45 postpartum women without PFD as a control group.
finding: The study found significant differences in various pelvic floor ultrasound measurements between women who had vaginal deliveries versus cesarean sections, and between women with PFD versus healthy controls.
mod_finding: BSD, bladder neck movement length, and urethral posterior horn were significantly higher in the vaginal delivery group compared to the selective cesarean section group.
